New York, NY

A New York HFT that has been consistently profitable for over a decade and doubled its PnL last year. Small, well-capitalised and deliberately low-profile, they're looking for one person to own their engineering function end to end.

• Based in, or willing to relocate to, New York

added.title: Head of Systems Engineering
added.description:
Own the system-level vision that turns first-of-a-kind fusion hardware into a cohesive, scalable reality—leading the integration of breakthrough science and engineering on the path to commercial fusion energy.  
The Head of Systems Engineering will lead the systems engineering function at   Realta  Fusion,  establishing  technical requirements, driving system integration, and ensuring our magnetic mirror fusion devices meet performance, safety, and operational  objectives . This senior technical leadership role demands  expertise  in complex system architecture, requirements management, and integration of multidisciplinary subsystems. You will bridge plasma physics, mechanical, electrical, nuclear, and  controls  engineering teams to ensure coherent system design and successful execution from experimental devices through commercial deployment. The ideal candidate combines deep systems engineering  expertise  with strategic leadership, thriving in a first-of-a-kind hardware environment where disciplined systems thinking directly  impacts  our ability to deliver commercial fusion energy.    
Realta Fusion is a rapidly growing start-up developing compact magnetic mirror fusion energy systems to address the biggest challenge of our time – tackling global climate change while ensuring a sufficient energy supply for at least ten billion people on (and off) earth. We are building a team with diverse talents dedicated to making fusion energy a  real  solution to humanity’s most pressing problem .  
Key Responsibilities

Systems Architecture & Requirements

Define and maintain system architecture for fusion devices across experimental, pilot, and commercial product lines 
Establish and manage technical requirements from physics performance through operational, safety, and regulatory constraints 
Lead system decomposition and allocation of requirements to subsystems and components  
Develop and  maintain  interface control documents across mechanical, electrical, plasma, and control systems  
Drive design trades balancing performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and risk    

Integration & Verification

Lead system integration activities ensuring subsystems work together to meet top-level requirements 
Define verification and validation strategy including analysis, testing, inspection, and demonstration 
Oversee commissioning and acceptance testing of fusion devices and major subsystems  
Manage technical reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) ensuring design maturity and readiness  
Drive resolution of integration issues and  interface  conflicts across engineering disciplines    

Team Leadership & Development

Build, lead, and mentor systems engineering team (initially 2-3, scaling to 8-12)  
Establish systems engineering processes, tools, and best practices for fusion development 
Recruit systems engineers with experience in complex hardware integration    
Develop systems engineering capability across the broader engineering organization    

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Partner with plasma physics to translate physics requirements into engineering specifications  
Work with mechanical, electrical, nuclear, and controls leads to ensure integrated system design  
Coordinate with operations on maintainability, operability, and lifetime performance requirements    
Support manufacturing and assembly planning to ensure buildability and integration sequence  

Program Support & Risk Management

Provide systems engineering support to experimental campaigns and pilot plant development programs 
Lead technical risk assessment and develop mitigation strategies for system-level risks 
Support project management with integrated schedules, technical dependencies, and critical path analysis    
Represent systems engineering perspective in executive decision-making on technical priorities and resource allocation    

  External Engagement

Represent systems engineering capabilities to investors, partners, and technical stakeholders  
Collaborate with national laboratories and research institutions on systems engineering best practices for fusion 
Engage with regulatory agencies on system safety analysis and compliance strategies    

Qualifications

Education & Experience

BS in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred 
15+ years systems engineering experience in complex hardware programs (aerospace, defense, energy, accelerators, research facilities)  
5+ years leading systems engineering teams or serving as chief engineer on major programs    
Demonstrated  track record  integrating multidisciplinary systems from requirements through commissioning    

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in systems engineering processes including requirements management, functional analysis, interface management, and V&V  
Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and control systems to  facilitate  integration across disciplines    
Proficiency  with systems engineering tools (DOORS, Cameo,  modeling  and simulation)    
Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approaches    
Knowledge of systems safety analysis (FMEA, fault trees, hazard analysis)    
Familiarity with technical reviews, configuration management, and engineering change processes    

Leadership & Execution

Proven ability to lead technical teams and influence across organizational boundaries 
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with systems-level thinking  
Excellent communication skills translating between technical specialists and executive leadership    
Experience making critical technical decisions with incomplete information and competing constraints    
Comfortable in fast-paced environments balancing rigor with speed of execution    

Applicants who do not meet the entire job specification are encouraged to apply.

Compensation & Benefits

What we are working on is hard… and hugely important. Realta Fusion is assembling a talented team bound together by a passion to solve humanity’s biggest challenge with first-of-a-kind technology. Additionally, Realta offers:  
Competitive compensation package, including equity stock options 
Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance, plus a 401(k) 
Flexible paid time off (PTO) to support work-life balance  
Work and live in Madison, Wisconsin — one of America’s most livable and vibrant cities  

We value diversity as a critical factor in innovation and believe a diverse team is necessary to solve the toughest problems. We aim to create an inclusive environment that unleashes the full creativity of our team members from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. We provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals based on merit and without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.

added.title: Senior Manager, Genome Portal Engineering
added.description:
Ready to shape the future of science and global health? A global nonprofit that provides trusted biological materials for science and health, ATCC is hiring a Senior Manager, Genome Portal Engineering
to lead the modernization, development, and long-term evolution of the ATCC Genome Portal and related digital biology platforms. Embedded within the Sequencing & Bioinformatics Center, this hybrid role in Gaithersburg, MD provides technical leadership for a cloud-based platform that delivers genomic data products and capabilities to scientific users. The position will guide platform architecture, engineering execution, user experience, and the transition of development capabilities while collaborating with scientists, bioinformatics teams, product stakeholders, IT, cybersecurity, and external partners to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing applications.

Seeking Senior Manager, Genome Portal Engineering, ideally with experience leading development of cloud-based software products or scientific data platforms and building applications used by scientists, researchers, or other technical end users, preferably with life science industry experience. Join ATCC and be part of a team that supports the global scientific community with trusted, authenticated biological materials.

Responsibilities

Platform Development and Modernization: Lead the design, development, and delivery of the Genome Portal and related digital biology platforms, driving enhancements that improve usability, scalability, and long-term platform sustainability.
Engineering Leadership and Execution: Oversee day-to-day engineering activities, including sprint planning, technical direction, code reviews, deliverable acceptance, release readiness, and engineering best practices across internal and external contributors.
Architecture and Integration: Guide architecture decisions and oversee backend services, APIs, data integration layers, and integrations with enterprise systems, internal data sources, and external repositories.
User Experience and Application Development: Drive the development of intuitive, user-centered applications and reusable UI components that enable scientists and technical users to efficiently access, explore, and utilize genomic data products.
Team and Partner Management: Coordinate external development partners, help identify future engineering resource needs, and serve as a primary technical interface with product management, IT, cybersecurity, and other stakeholders.
Platform Reliability and Risk Management: Ensure platform performance, security, maintainability, and resilience while identifying and mitigating risks related to infrastructure, scalability, and total cost of ownership.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirement: Bachelor's degree and 12 years of experience, or equivalent experience (Master's degree and 8 years, PhD and 5 years, or HS Diploma and 16 years).
Demonstrated leadership of professional-level engineering teams with responsibility for operational execution, performance management, and alignment to organizational objectives.
Experience leading the design, development, and support of scalable, secure, and maintainable software platforms, web applications, or SaaS products, including backend services, APIs, and data integration layers.
Proven ability to direct engineering execution, including sprint planning, technical direction, code reviews, release readiness, and development standards.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders while integrating platforms with enterprise systems and external data sources.
Experience overseeing internal and external development resources to deliver high-quality engineering outcomes.
Preferred: Experience supporting genomic data platforms, bioinformatics, sequencing, life sciences, or scientific data environments.
Preferred: Experience developing applications for scientific or technical end users, including data exploration, visualization, and user-centered workflows.
Preferred: Experience with modern frontend development, reusable UI component frameworks, cloud-based platforms, and complex data-intensive applications.

Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $220,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional incentive compensation including regular merit increases and the corporate bonus program.

We Invest in You

Health & Wellness:
Comprehensive medical coverage and company paid Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, AD&D, and paid parental leave
Work life balance with Paid Holidays and PTO
Fitness and cell phone subsidies, and additional benefits such as legal services, pet insurance and additional supplemental coverage.
Employee Assistance Program offering around-the-clock counseling

Financial security:
401(a) (6% employer contribution) and 403(b) (2% match) retirement plans
Exceptional career advancement opportunities, recognition, and rewards
Corporate bonus program

Mission Focused:
Non-profit organization supporting critical life science research
We give scientists the tools they need to make discoveries that improve and save lives
Contribute to community involvement and social responsibility

Join ATCC, where we fuel your success, well-being, and development. We're a mission-focused non-profit Equal Opportunity Employer, celebrating a century of supporting global public health. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Shape the future of science with us.

added.title: Senior Engineering Operations Manager
added.description:
STV is seeking a Senior Engineering Operations Manager
to serve as a trusted operations leader and subject matter expert supporting transit and rail clients nationwide. This highly consultative role partners directly with agency leadership to guide operational strategy, readiness, and implementation for new systems, service expansions, and complex transit programs.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on experience at a senior level within a public transit agency environment and understands the full lifecycle of operations and maintenance planning—from concept through testing, commissioning, and start-up. This individual will provide practical, real-world insight to help agencies deliver safe, reliable, and efficient service across multiple transit modes.

Responsibilities

Serve as a senior advisor to transit agency clients on operations, maintenance, and system readiness initiatives
Lead development of Operations & Maintenance (O&M) plans and operational frameworks for new system start-ups and expansions
Support testing & commissioning activities, system integration testing, and operational readiness planning

Provide subject matter expertise in control center operations, service delivery, and vehicle maintenance strategy
Develop Concepts of Operations (ConOps), pre-revenue operations plans, and transition strategies
Collaborate with engineering, systems, and program management teams to align operational requirements with design and construction
Interface directly with client leadership and stakeholders to provide guidance, risk mitigation strategies, and best practices
Mentor internal staff and support business development efforts within STV’s transit systems practice

Qualifications

25+ years of progressive experience in public transit operations
Senior-level leadership experience within a transit agency environment
Experience across multiple transit modes, including: Light Rail, Commuter Rail, Heavy Rail/Subway, and Bus Operations
Strong working knowledge of: Control Center Operations, Vehicle maintenance and lifecycle planning, Operational readiness and system start-up

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing Testing & Commissioning Plans
System Integration Test Planning
New system start-up and transition planning
Experience supporting major capital or system expansion programs
Consulting or advisory experience supporting public agencies

Compensation Range

$116,930.89 - $133,635.31

STV offers the following benefits

Health insurance, including an option with a Health Savings Account
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care and Transit and Parking where applicable)
Disability insurance
Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment
401(k) Plan
Retirement Counseling
Employee Assistance Program
Paid Time Off (starting at 16 days)
Paid Holidays (9 days)
Back-Up Dependent Care (up to 10 days per year)
Parental Leave (up to 80 hours)
Continuing Education Program
Professional Licensure and Society Memberships

STV is committed to paying all of its employees in a fair, equitable, and transparent manner. The listed pay range is STV’s good-faith salary estimate for this position. Please note that the final salary offered for this position may be outside of this published range based on many factors, including but not limited to geography, education, experience, and/or certifications.

We encourage you to apply if STV’s work and values resonate with you. added.title: Director of Solution Architecture - AI Infrastructure and Cloud
added.description:
Job Description

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

As the Director of Solution Architecture, you will serve as the executive technical leader bridging Commercial, Product Management, and Field Operations. You will recruit, mentor, and lead a high-caliber team of Principal Solutions Architects, establishing global reference architecture, customer onboarding frameworks, and technical field enablement. You will act as an executive sponsor for tier-1 enterprise accounts, ensuring customer success across bare-metal compute, platform orchestration, and FinOps.

Job Requirements

Basic Qualifications: Experience: 15+ years of technical architecture/engineering experience in cloud infrastructure, high-density AI/HPC, or neocloud environments.
People Leadership: 5+ years of experience leading, hiring, and managing high-performing Solution Architecture or Technical Account Management teams.
Cloud & AI Breadth: Strong technical fluency across GPU acceleration (NVIDIA DGX/Blackwell), container orchestration (Kubernetes), high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), and cloud cost models.

 Preferred Qualifications: Proven track record of supporting multi-million dollar enterprise AI cloud commitments (e.g., Microsoft, tier-1 AI labs).
Deep understanding of distributed LLM training frameworks (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, Ray) and inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM).
Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field.

Job Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Scale: Build, mentor, and scale a world-class team of AI Solution Architects and HPC specialists across key North American hubs.
Field Execution & Strategy: Establish repeatable architecture frameworks, customer PoC blueprints, and technical discovery loops to accelerate enterprise deal cycles.
Executive Customer Sponsorship: Act as the primary executive technical advisor for tier-1 enterprise clients, leading architecture design reviews for multi-thousand GPU deployments.
Commercial & Product Alignment: Partner closely with Commercial leadership on high-stakes proposals, while synthesizing field telemetry and customer requirements into direct feedback for Product Management.
Technical Thought Leadership: Represent IREN at major industry events, authoring whitepapers and reference designs on high-density GPU deployment, liquid cooling, and green AI infrastructure.

Job Benefits

The IREN Package  
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.   
Compensation  
Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
Total Compensation package may be inclusive of short-term and long-term incentives.
Relocation (as applicable and based on successful candidate circumstances)

Health & Wellness  
Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage – 100% company paid for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
Company-paid life and disability insurance
Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High-Deductible Health Plan
Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources

Financial Well-Being  
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Financial wellness tools and resources

Time Off & Flexibility  
Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Flexible work arrangements

Growth & Development  
Opportunities for advancement and internal mobility
Training and personal development opportunities

Lifestyle & Culture  
Company events and team-building activities

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!   
IE US Operations Inc.,  the employing entity and proud member of the IREN group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. 
We are committed to evaluating qualified applicants and do not discriminate against protected characteristics under applicable legislation.   By applying for this position and submitting your resume and application materials, you consent to the processing of your personal information in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Statement available on our website at  www.iren.com .
